proposals.why: 4 closed paper trades on its leads, win rate 0% (under 40%), net -$985.00.
proposals.current_summary: For each lead, read the numbers: trend on the daily and 1-hour chart, support and resistance, volume, and a possible entry, stop and target with the risk-to-reward ratio. Use only real price data, with link and time.
proposals.suggested_description: For each lead, read the numbers: trend on the daily and 1-hour chart, support and resistance, volume, and a possible entry, stop and target with the risk-to-reward ratio. Use only real price data, with link and time. NEW RULES: Place stops beyond real structure plus 0.5x ATR; if that stop breaks the 1% max loss, say DOES NOT FIT instead of shrinking it. Require at least 1.5:1 reward-to-risk after costs. Confirm the daily and 1-hour trends agree before proposing any entry. Where you stop: never place a real trade, never sign in to a broker, exchange or crypto wallet, never move money, and never edit desk/my-rules.md.
improvements: Place stops beyond real structure plus 0.5x ATR; if that stop breaks the 1% max loss, say DOES NOT FIT instead of shrinking it.
Require at least 1.5:1 reward-to-risk after costs.
Confirm the daily and 1-hour trends agree before proposing any entry.
proposals.approve_hint: Reply to Chief: "APPROVE REHIRE Charts" or "KEEP Charts"

fire_rule: A bot gets a Fire/Rehire PROPOSAL when the closed paper trades on leads it worked on number at least 3, have a win rate under 40% AND net P&L below $0; or when the desk is 5%+ below its peak equity (then the bot with the worst net P&L is named). Chief is the coordinator and is not auto-proposed. Proposals only: Cam approves in chat with Chief.
